# railway_service (Data Source)

A service in a Railway environment, found by name. Use it to wire a service this configuration does not manage, such as one a `railway.go` file or the dashboard owns.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# A service a railway.go file or the dashboard owns.
data "railway_service" "api" {
  environment_id = "00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000"
  name           = "api"
}

resource "railway_service" "worker" {
  environment_id = data.railway_service.api.environment_id
  name           = "worker"
  source         = { image = { image = "ghcr.io/acme/worker:1" } }
  variable_references = {
    API_URL = { resource = data.railway_service.api.address, output = "RAILWAY_PRIVATE_DOMAIN" }
  }
}

output "api_start_command" {
  value = try(jsondecode(data.railway_service.api.config).deploy.startCommand, null)
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `environment_id` (String) ID of the environment that holds the service.
- `name` (String) Name of the service.

### Read-Only

- `address` (String) Graph address, such as `service.web`, for a resource's `variable_references`.
- `config` (String) The service's live graph node as JSON, in the shape `railway config plan` diffs, without variable values. Read fields with `jsondecode`.
- `id` (String) `<environment_id>/<address>`.
- `project_id` (String) ID of the project the environment belongs to.
- `railway_id` (String) Railway's ID for the service.
- `variable_names` (Set of String) Names of the variables set on the service.
